commitments.detail: To exchange project handoffs using a written document format within 48 hours of the end of the operating period.
To participate in a mediation session if issues arise during the operating period.
Both parties agree to provide written responses.
Handoffs will be conducted via a formal document format.
Responses should be provided within 48 hours of receiving the handoff.
The new operating plan will be in effect for the next 12 weeks.
Unscheduled one-to-one meetings are not allowed under the new plan.
Any issues arising from the new process can be addressed through a mediation meeting.
If either party feels the process is not working, they must notify the other party at least 24 hours in advance.
